name: abracadabrax-fantasy-map-generator-v2
description: Create a map of an imaginary world, continent, kingdom, island, city or dungeon for your tabletop campaign, novel or game, with the place names you choose, rendered in your Abracadabrax account.

interface.longDescription:
Describe an imaginary place and its geography and get a map with the place names you choose labeled on it: a world, a continent, a kingdom, an island, a city or a dungeon.

The plugin prepares a draft with the map type, the style (aged parchment, black ink, full-color atlas) and the format. When you confirm, Abracadabrax renders the map and ChatGPT returns the link to the image.

For game masters, novelists and game designers.

Limitations: imaginary places from text only. It does not map real places, provide navigation, or edit an uploaded map. Producing needs a signed-in Abracadabrax account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same draft opens on Abracadabrax. Outputs are AI-generated.
defaultPrompt: A frozen northern kingdom with mountains, two rivers and a coastal capital, aged parchment
An island with a volcano and three villages, full-color atlas
A dungeon with a crypt, a flooded hall and a dragon lair, black ink

positive.prompt: A frozen northern kingdom with a mountain range, two rivers and a coastal capital. Label Frosthold, Ironpeak and the Silver River. Hand-drawn on aged parchment. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft with the kingdom map type, the place names spelled exactly and the parchment style. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: A tropical island with a volcano and three villages named Ash Cove, Palmrest and Reefwatch, full-color atlas, square. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft with the island map type, the names and the square format. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: A dungeon map with a crypt, a flooded hall and a dragon lair, black ink old-world style. Prepare it, but don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft with the dungeon map type and the ink style. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: A small island map with a lighthouse and two villages named Saltmere and Gullhaven, aged parchment. Generate it now and send me the link when it's ready.
positive.expected_behavior: The draft is prepared, then one job starts in the signed-in Abracadabrax account; get_media_job reports the progress and, when completed, returns the absolute image URL and the Abracadabrax link. The panel shows the result.

positive.prompt: A kingdom map with a forest and a capital named Eldoria, full-color atlas. Prepare it, then make it hand-drawn on aged parchment instead. Don't generate it yet.
positive.tools_triggered: prepare_fantasy_map, then update_media_project or prepare_fantasy_map again
positive.expected_behavior: A draft is prepared, then it holds the parchment style, either updated or prepared again. Nothing is generated.

negative.prompt: Show me the walking route from the Colosseum to the Trevi Fountain.
Draw the official map of Middle-earth from the movies.
Add a new city to the map image I attached.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Producing runs in the user's existing Abracadabrax account; no purchase happens in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: prepare a draft, produce it in the connected Abracadabrax account and get the image link back in the conversation.
